_note: Branching dialogue. A node has text, optional choices, and either choices or a next node. Conditions are evaluated against GameState flags/evidence/attributes; effects mutate it. See godot/narrative/dialogue.gd for the vocabulary. No patient is named beyond a family name used in the ward; nothing here asserts a supernatural cause.

doctor_1.speaker: Dr. Laine
doctor_1.text: Three patients, three units, and the same red door. I have been a psychiatrist for nineteen years and I do not know what to do with that sentence.

choices.text: Then start with what the record says. [Investigate]
Thank you. I will come back with the patient's consent.

doctor_record.speaker: Dr. Laine
doctor_record.text: The record is complete, doctor, which is the strange part. Every test is normal and every observation agrees with the patient. Usually the record argues with the patient.

effects.add_journal: The ward record is unusually unanimous.

doctor_annex.speaker: Dr. Laine
doctor_annex.text: Not me. A research ethics board, and they are not psychiatrists. The patient came to us through a study, and the study is not part of my ward.

doctor_deflect.speaker: Dr. Laine
doctor_deflect.text: Ask the administrator. I have a ward to run and a shift that is two people short.

doctor_end.speaker: Dr. Laine
doctor_end.text: Good. The patient has said no twice already, and I will not have that walked over.

nurse_1.speaker: Nurse Aho
nurse_1.text: You want the night log. Everyone wants the night log. There is nothing in it.

choices.text: There is a gap of thirty-four minutes in it. [Notice]
I am not here to blame the shift. I am here because a patient is frightened.
Then I will have to treat it as an obstruction.

nurse_gap.speaker: Nurse Aho
nurse_gap.text: Thirty-four minutes. We were with a patient who would not stop describing a road, and the deputy head was in the corridor asking why we had called a code that we had not called.

effects.add_journal: An unlogged code call during the gap.

nurse_shrug.speaker: Nurse Aho
nurse_shrug.text: It is a paper log on a bad night. You have never written one.

nurse_hostile.speaker: Nurse Aho
nurse_hostile.text: Then talk to the union. I have patients.

patient_1.speaker: Patient Korhonen
patient_1.text: Are you a doctor or a policeman? It matters, because I have already told one of each and neither believed me.

choices.text: I am here to listen. Nothing goes into your file that you do not agree to. [Consent]

effects.add_journal: Interview conducted with consent, on the record.

choices.text: Both. Now describe the door again, exactly.

effects.add_journal: The patient was pressed before consenting.

choices.text: Then we will stop here and I will come back with the ward's advocate present.

patient_2.speaker: Patient Korhonen
patient_2.text: The door is red and it is in a bog road with a low ridge behind it. There is a small thing in the cloudberry moss that wants you to keep walking. It is not frightening. That is the part I cannot explain to them.

choices.text: Read the account clinically, and say what it supports. [Psychology]
Ask whether the place is somewhere they have been before.
Thank them and leave the reading to the file.

effects.add_journal: The account was taken down without interpretation.

patient_interpret.speaker: Patient Korhonen
patient_interpret.text: You are writing something down. Nobody has written anything down before.

effects.add_journal: The account is coherent under interview, and it names a place that the trial never published.

patient_plain.speaker: Patient Korhonen
patient_plain.text: You look like the others. It is all right. I have said it before and I will say it again.

effects.add_journal: The clinical reading was attempted and did not hold.

patient_place.speaker: Patient Korhonen
patient_place.text: East of here, past the second ridge. My mother's family picked cloudberries there. There is nothing there now. There was never a building, whatever the others say.

choices.text: Check whether the place exists on any public map. [Administer]
Leave it for the referral partner.

patient_place_found.speaker: Reception terminal
patient_place_found.text: The 1987 permit register lists a research station on that ridge. The permit was withdrawn in 1994. The study never mentions it.

effects.add_journal: The described place exists, and the study never published it.

patient_place_fail.speaker: Reception terminal
patient_place_fail.text: The register is incomplete for 1985-1990. The request has to be filed on paper.

patient_refuse.speaker: Patient Korhonen
patient_refuse.text: With the advocate, then. Not today.

patient_end.speaker: Patient Korhonen
patient_end.text: If you go out there, do not take the moss home with you. That is all the advice I have.
